verdict.rationale: While Semgrep documents local, offline scanning where code is not uploaded by default (semgrep-gh-2), there is no evidence of explicit data retention policies, deletion controls, or account/data-purge mechanisms for the AppSec Platform (which stores findings/PR comments/secrets data). Missing for 10: documented retention windows, a deletion/export API or UI, and any compliance statement (GDPR/CCPA) covering findings or scan data.
